sentences.text: This is the first application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail who has been arrested on 15-03-3023 by police Station Jamner, District Guna in connection with crime No.76 of 2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 456 and 376 of IPC.

As per prosecution story, on 01-03-2023 at around 11:20 pm the prosecutrix who is a married lady aged around 25 years along with her husband lodged a report at Police Station Jamner against the present applicant alleging therein that prior to 15 days of the incident her husband had gone out of station for labour work and before six days, i.e. on 24-02- 2023 her distant relative i.e. the present applicant accused came to her house in between 09:00- 10:00 in the night and told her for some food as he is hungry. Thereafter, she served Roti to him and then the applicant told her due to late night he may be permitted to sleep here.
Thereafter, the applicant slept outside the house and she along with her aunt Laxmi slept inside the house.

In the night at around 11:00 the applicant entered Kanhaiyalal Bheel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159267976/
1 the room by opening the bolt and slept near her and pressed her mouth by clothes and committed forcibly sexual intercourse with her and thereafter fled away.

sentences.text: On hearing her hue and cry, her mother-in-law Rodibai, sister-in-law (nanad) Nirmabai and Shriram Bheel came there who saw applicant running from the spot and thereafter she narrated the incident to them and after returning her husband from Rajasthan, she also told the incident to him.
On the basis of aforesaid, Crime was registered.
The applicant was arrested.
The prosecutrix was sent for medical examination but no definite opinion regarding commission of rape has been given by doctor.
After completion of investigation and other formalities, charge sheet has been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 15-03-2023.
The prosecutrix is a major lady and is a consenting party.
Charge sheet has been filed and conclusion of trial will take some time.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
There is no possibility of his absconding or tampering with the prosecution case.
On such premises, learned counsel for the applicant prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Both the Advocates are heard.
Case diary perused.

Looking to the facts & circumstances of the case, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash surety of Rs.25,000/- along with a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he shall be released on bail.
Applicant will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.

In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/-
shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
CC as per rules

. 
(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE MKB Kanhaiyalal Bheel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159267976/
